title: Data pipelines and SQL
description: Conventions for Data pipelines and SQL.

rules.title: Idempotent loads
rules.text: Make loads idempotent with upserts or partition overwrites so reruns are safe.

rules.title: Schema contracts
rules.text: Validate incoming schemas and fail loudly on unexpected changes.

rules.title: Partition and cluster
rules.text: Partition large tables by a date column and filter on it in queries.

rules.title: No SELECT star
rules.text: List columns explicitly instead of SELECT * in production queries.

rules.title: Readable SQL
rules.text: Structure complex SQL with named CTEs and consistent keyword casing.

rules.title: Data quality checks
rules.text: Add row count, null and freshness checks at pipeline boundaries.
